facts.fact: The Ministry of Local Government says all nine modules of the National Digital Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system are digitalised, birth and death among them with marriage, divorce, annulment, recognition, adoption, guardianship and legitimization; the text gives no year, so the document's publication date is used.
facts.system: National Digital Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system

facts.fact: The Ministry of Local Government says the last two registers, guardianship and legitimization, were launched on a Tuesday, completing the digitalisation of all nine modules; the text gives no year and the publication date is used, though it describes the completion as ahead of a 2024 schedule.
facts.system: National Digital Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system
